sources.title: Approvals overview
sources.scope: Project Operations approval and recall context, as verified in the approved research.
supported_claims: Approval records relate to time, expense, and material entries.
Approval creates actuals; cancel or recall can reverse them.
sources.limitations: Only context for reading synthetic evidence. No approval, recall, actual creation, or Dynamics connection occurs. Revision selection, export schema, and cutoff rules are fictional sample policy.

sources.title: Proforma invoices
sources.scope: Draft review context for Project Operations Integrated with ERP.
supported_claims: Proforma review adds a review of approved and unbilled transactions.
sources.limitations: No Dynamics import/API compatibility is claimed. Synthetic local recommendations do not create or adjust an invoice. Pricing, caps, receipts, and reconciliation tolerance are not rules asserted by this source.

sources.title: Confirm a proforma project-based invoice
supported_claims: Confirmation makes the invoice read-only and creates financial actuals.
sources.limitations: The procedure stops before confirmation and performs no financial actuals creation, AR/GL posting, sending, reimbursement, or customer contact.
